security.item: Log no longer downloadable: the log was written to the site's /logs folder, where visitors could download it (it holds visited URLs, referrers and stack traces). It now goes to Joomla's log folder (Global Configuration > System) as a .php file that stops as soon as it is opened from a browser, the same way Joomla protects its own logs. Rotated logs keep the protection.
Old logs removed on update: updating removes the old router_trace.log files (and their rotated and cleared copies) from the site's /logs folder, and says how many it removed.
Safe log file name: the "Log File Name" setting is reduced to a plain name (letters, numbers, - and _), so it can't point outside the log folder or change the file type.
Log viewer escaping: every value from the log is now escaped before it is shown in the viewer.

fix.item: Untranslated messages: Clear Log, View and the access/token errors returned raw language keys (e.g. PLG_SYSTEM_ROUTERTRACER_LOG_CLEARED); the plugin's language file is now loaded for every log viewer request.

addition.item: File check: the plugin settings now show whether every installed file matches the released version, and warn when an install or update did not finish (for example a file left at 0 bytes)
